**Finding: compliant** (rule NOSOLICIT — Non-solicitation of employees binding Customer)

The agreement contains no non-solicitation, no-hire, or anti-poaching covenant of any kind. Searches for "solicit", "hire", "employ" and "induce" surfaced only:

- **§13 Shared Resources (p0108–p0116)** — access to Commerce One operations, consulting and engineering personnel, Employee NDA/Invention Agreement warranties, and Developments ownership; no restriction on Corio engaging those personnel.
- **§14.5 Independent Contractors (p0126)** — status disclaimer only.
- **Exhibit D §5 Personnel (p0203)** — each party dedicates a sales/marketing employee to joint promotion.

This sits at the **preferred** position (no non-solicit binding the Customer), so no redline was proposed. Worth noting for negotiation awareness: since the restriction is absent, Corio remains free to recruit Commerce One personnel who work alongside it under §13 — we should resist any attempt by Commerce One to add a non-solicit in later drafts, and if one is unavoidable, hold to a mutual 12-month restriction limited to personnel directly involved in the services with general-advertising and unsolicited-approach carve-outs.
